events.title: Blues on Broadbeach 2026 — 25th Anniversary Festival
events.location: Broadbeach City Centre (19 stages across parks, streets, venues)
events.source: Blues on Broadbeach / Experience Gold Coast
events.description: Four-day free music festival celebrating 25 years, transforming Broadbeach into a rhythm and blues mecca with 19 stages across parks, streets and venues. Features Ian Moss, Ruthie Foster, The Bamboos, MonoNeon, Robert Finley, Grace Cummings, Hussy Hicks, and many more. Genuinely community-oriented with natural mingling between stages and crowd discovery.

events.title: Blues on Broadbeach Sunday Ticket — The Teskey Brothers + Judith Hill + Ash Grunwald
events.description: Premium ticketed closing night of the festival featuring Australian soul-blues heavyweights The Teskey Brothers in their festival debut, joined by Grammy-winning international artist Judith Hill and Ash Grunwald. Premium experience with exclusive VIP bar and intimate artist conversations for Twelve Bar Society members.

events.title: Bond University Faculty of Law Twilight Seminar: 'The Anti-System Trump — And What Do We Do About It?'
events.location: Bond University, Faculty of Law (Building 4, Level 3), Robina
events.description: Faculty of Law public seminar exploring how Trump's trade policy signals US willingness to act against the international system it once built. Open to the community; no background required. Examines geopolitics, systems thinking, and the Trump era's global impact. Includes free refreshments (vegan, GF, dairy-free available).

events.title: Ross Noble — Cranium of Curiosities
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, 135 Bundall Rd, Surfers Paradise
events.description: One of Australia's best-loved improvisational stand-up comedians, Ross Noble performs his characteristically digressive, surreal, genre-bending comedy. Intellectually playful and genuinely unpredictable—perfect for curious minds who value creative surprise and live spontaneity.

events.title: Twelve Bar Society 'In Conversation' Sessions — Ruthie Foster & Louie Shelton
events.description: Exclusive VIP membership program offering intimate 'In Conversation' sessions with blues legends Ruthie Foster and Louie Shelton, private VIP bar with up-close stage viewing, and access to a secret show. For those wanting deeper connection with the artists beyond the main festival stages.

events.title: HOTA Gallery — White Rabbit Collection Exhibition (Contemporary Chinese Art)
events.location: HOTA Gallery, 135 Bundall Rd, Surfers Paradise
events.description: World-class exhibition drawn from the White Rabbit Collection in Sydney—one of the Southern Hemisphere's most significant holdings of contemporary Chinese art. Free entry to HOTA Gallery; thoughtful, mixed-age crowd of art lovers. Perfect for an hour's visit before or after a live event.

events.title: Music of the Night — Tribute to Andrew Lloyd Webber
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: Live orchestrated tribute to Andrew Lloyd Webber's theatrical masterpieces from Phantom of the Opera, Cats, Evita, and beyond. Immersive live music experience with strong orchestration and emotional depth.

events.title: Miami Marketta — Street Food Night Market + Free Live Music
events.datetime: Wed 13, Thu 14, Fri 15, Sat 16 May, 5:00 PM onward
events.description: Laneway dining experience with 15+ international food vendors, free live music, and boutique bars. Weekly street food nights (Wed–Sat from 5pm) with no bookings needed. One of Gold Coast's best authentic recurring social scenes—naturally brings together creative, diverse crowds in an intimate, characterful setting.

events.title: Life Drawing Sessions with Live Music — Miami Marketta Studio 56
events.datetime: Check miamimarketta.com for May date (typically midweek)
events.description: Evening of life drawing with live music performed by original musicians. Open to all drawing levels—focus is on the creative process with a live model and musical accompaniment, not outcome. Attracts curious, creative people in an intimate community setting.

events.title: Gold Coast Social Work Expo 2026
events.location: Varsity Lakes Community Resource Centre, Varsity Lakes
events.description: Community-focused gathering bringing together social workers, students, allied-health providers, and community organisations to explore career pathways, systems thinking, and human-centred practice. Authentic, half-day learning event with panels and discussions—not a corporate sales pitch.

events.title: 2000s + 2010s Party — Miami Marketta
events.description: DJ dance party celebrating hits from the 2000s and 2010s in Miami Marketta's characterful laneway venue. Warm, social crowd in one of the Gold Coast's most authentic creative spaces.

events.title: Gold Coast Board Games Club — Weekly Meetup
events.datetime: Check meetup.com for exact date/time this week
events.description: Recurring community meetup (630+ members) for modern board games like Catan, Carcassonne, Ticket to Ride, Dominion. Open to ages 18+. Naturally fosters conversation with thoughtful, friendly people in a relaxed, social setting.

events.title: Life Drawing Sessions — Dust Temple, Currumbin
events.location: Dust Temple, 54 Currumbin Creek Rd, Currumbin Waters
events.description: Monthly evening of life drawing with live original music from local musicians. Open to all drawing levels. Focus on creative process, not outcome—attendees engage with drawing, live model, and musicians in a collaborative, authentic community space.

events.title: Flying Solo Gold Coast — Weekly Social Group Events
events.datetime: Multiple events throughout the week (check meetup.com)
events.cost: Free to join; some event costs apply; $10 annual fee for exclusive events
events.description: Active social group offering beach walks, bushwalks, monthly brunches, dinners at unique locations, road trips, weekends away, trivia/drag bingo, theatre, concerts, and food & wine experiences. Recurring community with diverse activities and mixed-age attendees.

events.title: Comedy Underground — Weekly Saturday Night Comedy
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: Weekly live comedy night at the Gold Coast's premier arts venue, presenting emerging and established comedians. Recurring community event ideal for discovering new voices and mixing with a lively, mixed-age crowd.

events.title: Australian Army Band Concert
events.location: Gold Coast (check Experience Gold Coast for venue)
events.description: Free or low-cost live concert by the Australian Army Band—a professional, distinctive ensemble offering community-oriented classical and contemporary music.

events.title: Gold Coast Board Games Meetup
events.datetime: Check meetup.com for exact date this week
events.description: Complementary board games and card games meetup for all experience levels. Recurring group focused on in-person gatherings and making friends while playing modern games. Naturally conversational community.
